pages.text: Grind items by hand — the manual version of a Millstone.\n\nHold right-click with the ingredient in your offhand (or in a container you're pointing at).

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text: $(li)Create's $(l)milling$() recipes$(br)$(li)Plus exclusive mortar recipes from datapacks\n\n$(italic)Every grind consumes 1 durability.$()

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)Grinding with nothing that matches costs $(l)no$() durability — invalid actions are free.$(br)$(li)For crushing-style processing, use the $(l)Crusher Mortar$() instead; it falls back to milling.
